target_customer: Fast-growing companies with entities in several countries (micro-multinationals) that need transfer pricing, intercompany agreements and R&D tax credit work
problem: Cross-border groups inherit a tax and legal burden that today needs a different law firm and advisor in each country, with Big Four work that is slow and unpredictably billed.
business_model: Subscription software with transfer pricing experts and accountants built in
product_category: Tax and transfer pricing software with services

founders.name: Juan Andrade
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CEO of Rebank in the TechCrunch seed article (2019). The YC page lists him as the only founder of Caribou. Education and prior employers not found in opened sources.

founders.name: Simon White
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder of Rebank in the TechCrunch seed article (2019). Not listed on the current YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Rebank at founding was a software layer over existing business bank accounts using account aggregation and payment initiation, standard integration engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: An interface layer on top of other banks had little structural protection and depended on third party banking access.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The TechCrunch article refers to legacy and challenger banks only in general terms. The company later moved away from the banking layer idea and relaunched as Caribou in 2024 in transfer pricing.

market_need_then: The 2019 TechCrunch article describes startups and mid-size companies juggling several bank accounts, with about 70 customers in the US, Canada and UK generating around 50 million dollars in transactions.

branding.domain_note: Currently uses usecaribou.com, not the plain .com. Rebank used rebanknow.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, positions itself against slow and unpredictably billed Big Four work.

rebrands.why: Not stated; the YC page says the company pivoted to Caribou in 2024

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand was found, and the name collides with other companies named Caribou, including a well-funded auto refinance company.

pivots.from: Rebank, a digital business banking layer over existing accounts for high-growth companies
pivots.to: Caribou, transfer pricing and tax software with experts built in
pivots.why: Not stated in sources opened; the YC page states the 2024 pivot to Caribou

outcome_analysis: Rebank was accepted into YC W19 after an earlier rejection and raised a 2.8 million dollar seed in December 2019 led by ADV. The banking layer idea does not appear to have scaled, and the YC page says the company pivoted to Caribou in 2024 with a focus on transfer pricing for micro-multinationals. It is still active with about 10 people, so the outcome is still open and the reasons for the pivot are not public.
notes: Unverified: a RuntimeWire article dated 2026-05-15 reports a 2.7M dollar seed for Caribou from Blue Wire Capital, Y Combinator, TinyVC and Venture Together; only one outlet seen and the page was behind a sign-in wall, so it is not recorded as a round. VCBacked lists an undisclosed seed in 2024-12, which conflicts. The 2019 seed amount is stated by TechCrunch and the Finextra headline. No competitor named in any source dated near 2018 to 2019 was found; the TechCrunch article names none. YC listing founding year differs (2023 or 2024) from the Rebank timeline of 2018.
